name: Intel Gaudi PyTorch Bridge README
notes: HabanaAI/gaudi-pytorch-bridge is where the Gaudi fork of PyTorch lives and how it is assembled. Described as 'several Python packages enabling Intel Gaudi functionality in PyTorch with minimal code changes'. The build recipe is the hardware constraint made visible: install the Gaudi software and driver from Habana's own installer script, then run scripts/install_torch_fork.sh with the VERSION and BUILD strings read out of habanalabs-installer.sh -v - i.e. the PyTorch fork build is version-locked to the Gaudi software stack release and you cannot choose a torch version independently. It also pulls habana-media-loader at the same VERSION.BUILD, and requires chmod +xw on /usr/lib/habanalabs plus a symlink of hl_logger headers into place - i.e. the build writes into system directories, which is not something a portable upstream framework requires. Build host is assumed Ubuntu 22.04. Repo metadata via GitHub API 2026-10-04: created 2024-09-29, last push 2026-07-13, 19 stars, 9 forks, 5 open issues, Apache-2.0, NOT archived.
